project_summary: Clinic management system with insurance billing and e-prescriptions

components.name: Patient records
components.description: Patient demographics, medical history, allergies and visit notes with versioning and attachment upload.

components.name: Insurance billing
components.description: Claims generation for several health insurers, eligibility checks, rejection handling and monthly reconciliation reports.

components.name: Electronic prescriptions
components.description: Digitally signed prescriptions with drug catalogue lookup, interaction warnings and QR code for pharmacy validation.

components.name: SMS appointment reminders
components.description: Automatic SMS reminders 24 hours before each appointment with confirmation and cancellation links.
